common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution single-character image-to-3D modelling reference. One adult male street trials rider, approximately 30 years old, warm natural medium skin, dark curly hair, restrained stubble, mustard hoodie, blue denim jeans, dark full-finger gloves and practical lace-up shoes. Believable adult anatomy and joint proportions. Full body including entire hair, hands and soles; upright relaxed symmetric A-pose, arms 40 degrees away from vertical, elbows almost straight, wrists straight, palms toward thighs, fingers individually readable and slightly apart, feet hip-width apart and pointing forward. Exact straight-on front orthographic view, eye-level camera, consistent scale, no foreshortening. Neutral soft studio illumination, no baked dramatic shadows or highlights. Transparent background, no floor or contact shadow. Sculpted game-character render with readable three-dimensional form and restrained realistic materials. No bike, bench, props, helmet, text, grid, logos, watermarks, other people, skin-tight superhero torso, balloon shoulders, juvenile face, oversized hands, fused fingers or distorted knees. The existing Concept A image supplies clothing/identity direction only; do not copy its seated pose, bike, garage or lighting.

designs.name: Faithful Street
designs.variation: Balanced average-height athletic adult, grounded normal head size, moderately broad natural sloping shoulders, substantial forearms and calves. Classic loose cotton hoodie with believable shoulder seams and low folded hood, straight tapered indigo jeans with room around knees, charcoal canvas high-top sneakers with white sole edges and clearly constructed toe boxes. Match the grounded adult identity and tactile clothes of Concept A.

designs.name: Solid Workwear
designs.variation: A sturdier, slightly stockier adult with broader ribcage and strong thighs; relaxed neck and shoulders rather than inflated deltoids. Boxier heavyweight mustard cotton hoodie, roomy straight blue denim with modest wear at knee panels, dark leather/canvas ankle-height work sneakers with firm sole and anatomically proportionate feet. Clear face planes, short dense curly hair.

designs.name: Compact Trials Athlete
designs.variation: Compact adult athletic build, slightly shorter stature, strong thighs and calves, natural full forearms and relaxed trapezius. A fitted but comfortably loose mustard hoodie, medium-blue straight denim with convincing articulated fabric folds at knees and ankles, charcoal lace-up high-top shoes with white rubber soles. Mature angular face, textured loose curls. Practical mobility with no spindly limbs.

designs.name: Relaxed Premium
designs.variation: Natural adult proportions with a relaxed longer torso, substantial legs and realistic hands. Soft slightly oversized mustard hoodie with a few broad cloth folds, dark-blue straight-leg jeans draping cleanly over low charcoal lace-up skate shoes; detailed layered sole and toe cap. Adult lightly weathered face, slightly longer tousled curls. Premium realistic game asset, coherent quiet forms rather than exaggerated muscles or noisy photo texture.

designs.name: Readable Sculpted
designs.variation: A confident mature adult interpreted as clean sculpted game art: sturdy balanced build, head only subtly enlarged for game readability, natural sloping shoulders, broad readable facial planes and compact curls. Deliberately shaped mustard hoodie folds, straight blue jeans with clear knee/ankle construction and restrained denim weave, chunky but proportionate charcoal high-top canvas shoes with white soles. Softer realistic stylization, never a child or toy; readable hands and uninterrupted wrist/ankle anatomy.

nineAngleTarget: Create one 3 by 3 contact sheet of the SAME reference rider, exactly nine full-body views at yaw angles 0,40,80,120,160,200,240,280,320 degrees in row-major order. Every panel uses the same neutral A-pose, anatomy, identity, garment details, scale, orthographic camera height, soft neutral light and background. First panel is straight-on front. Entire hair, hands and shoes fit each panel. No bike, seating, action, changed clothing, additional subjects inside a panel, dramatic lighting or invented props. This is a concept target, not actual geometry or a verified reconstruction. No printed labels or text; the review board adds labels later.
